shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace/app /workspace/__agent_eval__ && echo "--- next.config ---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "--- tsconfig ---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | tr '>' '>\n' | grep -iE 'form|input|textarea|button|Contact'

cd /tmp
AID='$ACTION_ID_40517857a5fbfe66f4c87a6f6513c5627e327c10e0'

echo "=== TEST 1: valid submission (all three fields) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'http=%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3111/ \
  -F "$AID=" -F 'name=Ada' -F 'email=ada@example.com' -F 'message=Hello there'

echo "=== TEST 2: missing message ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'http=%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3111/ \
  -F "$AID=" -F 'name=Ada' -F 'email=ada@example.com'

echo "=== TEST 3: whitespace-only name ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'http=%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3111/ \
  -F "$AID=" -F 'name=   ' -F 'email=ada@example.com' -F 'message=Hi'

sleep 2
echo "=== SERVER LOG ==="
grep -E 'Saving contact message|validation failed|name:|email:|message:' /tmp/next.log

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
git status --short && echo "--- tsconfig diff ---" && git diff tsconfig.json
git status --short; echo "--- tsconfig diff ---"; git diff tsconfig.json
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo /workspace/next-env.d.ts; git status --short
